steps.name: Diagnose Feather public service (availability is not a build result)
Apply the identical reviewed source payload
Install locked dashboard dependencies on the macOS worker
Select installed stable Xcode 26 and verify the iOS SDK
Build and verify the iOS application
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
xcodebuild -version
export XSIGN_BUILD_NUMBER="${XSIGN_REQUESTED_BUILD:-1}"
python3 - <<'CHECK_BUILD'
import os,re
assert re.fullmatch(r'[1-9][0-9]{0,8}',os.environ['XSIGN_BUILD_NUMBER']), 'Use a positive numeric build number, at most 9 digits'
CHECK_BUILD
export XSIGN_RESULT_BUNDLE="$RUNNER_TEMP/xsign-build.xcresult"
make XSIGN_BUILD_NUMBER="$XSIGN_BUILD_NUMBER" 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/xsign-local-build.log"
python3 - <<'VERIFY_LOCAL_IPA'
from pathlib import Path
import zipfile,plistlib,os
p=Path('packages/X-SIGN.ipa')
with zipfile.ZipFile(p) as z:
    assert z.testzip() is None
    assert not any(n.lower().endswith(('.p12','.ipa')) for n in z.namelist()), 'Private signing keys or nested IPA must not be bundled'
    infos=[n for n in z.namelist() if n.startswith('Payload/') and n.count('/')==2 and n.endswith('/Info.plist')]
    assert len(infos)==1
    info_min=plistlib.loads(z.read(infos[0])).get('MinimumOSVersion','99.0')
    minimum=tuple((list(map(int,info_min.split('.')))+[0,0])[:3])
    assert minimum <= (15,0,0), 'IPA does not support iOS 15'
    assert plistlib.loads(z.read(infos[0])).get('UIFileSharingEnabled') is not True, 'File sharing must be disabled'
    info=plistlib.loads(z.read(infos[0]))
    assert info.get('CFBundleIdentifier')=='com.ipablack.xsign', 'Unexpected XSign bundle identifier'
    assert info.get('CFBundleDisplayName')=='XSign' and info.get('CFBundleName')=='XSign', 'Unexpected app name'
    icons=info.get('CFBundleIcons',{}).get('CFBundlePrimaryIcon',{})
    assert icons.get('CFBundleIconName')=='AppIcon' or icons.get('CFBundleIconFiles'), 'Built app has no primary icon'
    assert str(info.get('CFBundleVersion')) == os.environ['XSIGN_BUILD_NUMBER'], 'IPA build does not match requested build'
    executable=infos[0].rsplit('/',1)[0]+'/'+info['CFBundleExecutable']
    assert len(z.read(executable))>4096
    assert info.get('CFBundleShortVersionString')=='1.0'
    assert str(info.get('CFBundleVersion')) == os.environ['XSIGN_BUILD_NUMBER']
print('Verified the built IPA archive and app executable')
VERIFY_LOCAL_IPA

steps.name: Summarize actual native errors
steps.run:
python3 - <<'XSIGN_NATIVE_ERRORS'
from pathlib import Path
import os
root=Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])
errors=[]
for name in ['xsign-local-toolchain.log','xsign-local-build.log','xsign-local-checks.log']:
    path=root/name
    if not path.is_file():continue
    for line in path.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines():
        if any(marker in line for marker in ['error:', 'fatal error:', 'No usable stable Xcode', '** BUILD FAILED **']):
            if line not in errors:errors.append(line[:1800])
with Path(os.environ['GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY']).open('a') as output:
    output.write('## Native verification failed\n\n')
    output.write('\n'.join('    '+line for line in errors[:30]) if errors else 'Inspect the failing step and the XSign-native-logs artifact for the actual error.')
    output.write('\n\nFull native logs and the Xcode result bundle are preserved in XSign-native-logs. No app source is committed when verification fails.\n')
XSIGN_NATIVE_ERRORS

steps.name: Preserve native check and build logs

with Path(os.environ['GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY']).open('a') as f:
    f.write('## Source repository: manual setup required\n\nThe app build succeeded; ipablack/repo was NOT changed because XSIGN_CONTROL_TOKEN is missing.\nAdd a token with Contents + Workflows write access to ipablack/repo as this repository secret and rerun to initialize repo.json, xsign-config.json, ipa_manager.yml and studio.html automatically.\nThe complete files are also in XSign-Unified-Panel-and-Source for manual installation.\nThe current website is not deployed by this workflow.\n')
